verdict.rationale: Parsec's download page lists clients for Windows, macOS, Linux (Ubuntu), Android and a Chrome web client. Hosting is documented for Windows and macOS, so a Linux, Android or web viewer connecting to a Windows or macOS host is a cross-OS pairing the platform lists imply. Mobile coverage is Android-only in the evidence, hosting is limited to two OSes, and mixed-OS host/viewer sessions are never explicitly confirmed or corroborated hands-on. missing for 10: iOS/iPadOS client evidence, Linux hosting, explicit documentation of cross-OS host/viewer sessions, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, clients cover the desktop and mobile platforms I use, and host and viewer can run on different operating systems
